messages:
ana: heads up — noticed a spike in unassigned inbound leads around 15:12 PT. SLA shows >5m to owner for a ~200 lead batch. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: saw same. looks correlated with the HubSpot enrichment webhook backlog — payload retries piling up. :eyes:
sam: unassigned leads are hitting the round-robin but timing out before enrichment returns contact info, so default-owner fallback not triggering 100% of the time.
marta: can you paste a sample webhook failure? want to check our retry/backoff settings.
kevin: pasted below, it’s the hs-workflow retry loop. workflow_id=wf_8d9f2a — errors: 429 -> 502 -> timeout.
```
POST /integrations/hubspot/enrich
status: 502
body: {"error":"upstream timeout"}
headers: {"retry-after":"3"}
```
rebecca: if enrichment is slow we should prioritize handoff fallback earlier — suggestion: reduce debounce on enrichment gate from 30s to 6s for high-priority leads (enterprise & webinar).
ana: (typo) meant ana: +1 to that. Also, add a short-circuit: if round-robin attempt_count >= 2 and enrichment pending >10s, assign to default queue with tag "enrichment-pending".
kevin: ok. quick patch plan: 1) HubSpot workflow backoff tweak to linear 3s x 3, 2) reduce enrichment debounce to 6s for tags [webinar, pql, demo-request], 3) round-robin fallback threshold to 10s with default owner.
sam: can we also add a lightweight telemetry flag so we can count how often fallback happened? want to avoid over-assigning stale leads.
marta: yes — will emit lead.hand_off_reason = [enrichment_pending|assigned] and lead.hand_off_latency. ops-bot, schedule rollout canary?
ops-bot: deploy-plan queued: canary -> 10% marketing traffic in eu-west1, then 50% after 15m. CI run id: ci-1123. :robot_face:
kevin: rolling the hubspot workflow change now (small window). will monitor retries and SLA dashboard.
rebecca: also adding a short note to playbook: if enrichment fails repeatedly, run hs workflow wf_8d9f2a health probe and escalate to RevOps.
nana: (ana) thanks — keeping this thread as the coordination log. I'll update the inbound playbook and create a one-off alert for lead.hand_off_latency > 120s. :thumbsup:
